song.name: The Fall of the Covenant
song.plot: Realizing the golden age is over, Acheron orders the subterranean capital abandoned. The Covenant disperses into isolated cells across Eldoria to avoid attracting Nyktoros's gaze.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "empire of evil crumbles, world is free" piece with a false "force of good" chorus. The reworked version anchors it to the actual arc (~160 BGD): Acheron ordering the Covenant to abandon Sanguine Vaults and break into small isolated cells across Eldoria to evade Nyktoros's detection. Reworked to preserve the original per-line syllable counts exactly: verse 1/2 and bridge 9-8-8-8, chorus 10-8-8-8 ("Fall of the Covenant, a shattered tale"), final verse 8-8-8-8. User-corrected line: "Dispersing in the quiet night". Suggested song direction: melancholic, shattered, epic — slow mournful strings, sparse piano, broken percussion, the funeral of a dynasty.
